sources.excerpt: BC-2 Combo Drive by BOSS | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE BOSS BC-2 Combo Drive LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS OVERDRIVE DISTORTION Description The BOSS BC-2 gives you the sound of a classic “AC-inspired” British combo amp in a pedal format – but that’s just the beginning. With a single knob, you can directly influence several parameters that control the sound characteristics and thus choose from a variety of different sounds. Fix the perfect vintage twist or dial in more gain or cleaner sound from a wider range than the classic amp could have on its own. The BC-2 also gives you a natural and dynamic response to your pick playing regardless of the settings of the controls. This easy-to-use – yet technically complex – pedal takes you from authentic vintage sound to the more expansive sounds of the new generation.
